name: @thetis/harness-core
description: The default harness: the system prompt, the turn context line, every installed tool attached to the call, and the loop that sends it and runs the tools.

turnContext.help: Append a [Turn context: <weekday> <date> <time> <zone>] line to each message from the person, so the model knows when it is.

timeZone.help: The IANA zone of the turn context line, for example Europe/Berlin. Unset means the zone of the daemon.

modelStallMs.help: How long the model may send nothing at all before the turn asks whether to keep waiting. The work keeps running while the question is out. A value of 0 or less is ignored: there is no way to switch the question off.

toolStallMs.help: How long a tool may run without returning before the turn asks whether to keep waiting. Builds and test runs live here, so it is longer than the model's.

stallBackoff.help: What the silence allowance is multiplied by after each continue, so a second question about the same work comes later than the first. Never less than 1.

stallMaxMs.help: The longest the silence allowance grows to, however many times the same work was continued.

nudgeMs.help: How long one attempt at asking may take. An attempt that runs out counts as unanswered.

nudgeAttempts.help: How many attempts the question gets. When they are used up the work is cancelled: an unanswered question never keeps waiting.

nudgeModel.help: The model the question is put to. Unset means the turn's own model. Name a small fast model here when the turn's own model is a slow or expensive one, or one served by a provider you do not want to ask about itself.
